descripcion: What changes from one day to the next and cannot be learnt by heart: roadworks, removals and deliveries, rubbish and street washing, cafés and shops spilling onto the pavement, markets and festivals, storm debris, people standing about and the cleaning and maintenance clutter of a building.

categorias.obras: Works on the pavement and the road
categorias.comercio: Shops and cafés spilling into the way

subcategorias.reclamos: Signs and goods on the pavement
subcategorias.carreras: Races and tables in the street

barrera_new_jersey.descripcion: Long hollow plastic block filled with water or sand, wider at the bottom. Several are usually locked in a row: you can follow them with the cane like a high kerb.
barrera_new_jersey.imagen: Footprint of “Water-filled plastic barrier”: a rectangle, 1.20 by 0.50 metres, marked with the letters “Bn”.

fila_vallas_pies.nombre: Run of barriers with protruding feet
fila_vallas_pies.descripcion: Several works barriers hooked together in a line. A good hand guide, but every couple of steps a flat metal foot sticks out a hand's width into the path and trips you.
fila_vallas_pies.imagen: Footprint of “Run of barriers with protruding feet”: a long thin bar with feet crossing it and sticking out on both sides, 7.50 by 0.60 metres, marked with the letters “Fv”.

cinta_balizamiento.nombre: Barrier tape stretched at waist height
cinta_balizamiento.descripcion: Plastic tape tied between two posts or lamp posts at waist height. The cane passes underneath without touching it; in the wind it flutters and buzzes.
cinta_balizamiento.imagen: Footprint of “Barrier tape stretched at waist height”: a rectangle, 3.00 by 0.05 metres, hanging 0.90 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Cb”.

malla_naranja.descripcion: Soft plastic netting held on rods driven into the ground, waist high. It gives when pushed and the cane tip catches in the holes.
malla_naranja.imagen: Footprint of “Orange safety netting”: a rectangle, 5.00 by 0.10 metres, marked with the letters “Mn”.

zona_acotada_fachada.nombre: Area cordoned off with cones and tape
zona_acotada_fachada.descripcion: A stretch of pavement closed with cones and tape while a tree is pruned or a façade cleaned. The cane finds the cones but not the tape between them. Go round the outside.
zona_acotada_fachada.aviso: Cordoned area: no way through, something may fall from above.
zona_acotada_fachada.imagen: Footprint of “Area cordoned off with cones and tape”: a rectangle with cut corners, 4.00 by 2.50 metres, marked with the letters “Za”.

senal_obra_tripode.nombre: Roadworks sign on a low tripod
senal_obra_tripode.descripcion: Triangular metal sign on a folding tripod, knee to hip high. The legs splay into the path; knock it and it falls with a clatter.
senal_obra_tripode.imagen: Footprint of “Roadworks sign on a low tripod”: a triangle pointing to the front, 0.90 by 0.70 metres, marked with the letters “So”.

senal_contrapeso.nombre: Temporary sign on a weighted base
senal_contrapeso.descripcion: Thin post stuck in a long rubber block left on the pavement. The block trips you and the plate on top may be at face height.
senal_contrapeso.imagen: Footprint of “Temporary sign on a weighted base”: a rectangle, 0.40 by 0.80 metres, marked with the letters “Sc”.

baliza_luminosa.descripcion: Works lamp that flashes, on a round base on the ground. Up close you hear the click of each flash.
baliza_luminosa.imagen: Footprint of “Flashing warning beacon”: a circle, 0.25 by 0.25 metres, marked with the letters “Bl”.

zanja_abierta.descripcion: Long, narrow trench dug in the pavement with no barriers. The cane stops finding ground: a hole knee deep or more, with loose earth at the edge.
zanja_abierta.aviso: Open trench! The ground ends here: stop and go round.
zanja_abierta.imagen: Footprint of “Unprotected open trench”: a rectangle, 0.60 by 3.00 metres, marked with the letters “Za”.

pasarela_zanja.descripcion: Sheet-metal platform with a handrail on each side for crossing a trench. There is a small step on and off, it sounds hollow and takes one person at a time.
pasarela_zanja.aviso: Works footbridge: a step, a metal floor and a handrail on each side.
pasarela_zanja.imagen: Footprint of “Metal footbridge over a trench”: a rectangle, 1.00 by 2.50 metres, marked with the letters “Pz”.

plancha_acero.descripcion: Thick steel sheet laid on the ground to cover a trench. It has an edge two fingers high, booms and rocks underfoot and is very slippery when wet.
plancha_acero.aviso: Works plate: slippery and it rocks.
plancha_acero.imagen: Footprint of “Steel plate over a trench”: a rectangle, 1.50 by 2.00 metres, marked with the letters “Pa”.

arqueta_abierta.nombre: Open inspection chamber with no cover
arqueta_abierta.descripcion: A chamber in the ground with its cover removed. A square hole one step wide; the cover is usually propped up next to it.
arqueta_abierta.aviso: Open chamber! There is a hole in the ground: stop.
arqueta_abierta.imagen: Footprint of “Open inspection chamber with no cover”: a rectangle, 0.60 by 0.60 metres, marked with the letters “Aa”.

socavon.descripcion: A collapse in the ground with ragged edges and broken, loose slabs around it. You turn an ankle before you even reach the hole.
socavon.aviso: Sinkhole: the ground has sunk and is loose.
socavon.imagen: Footprint of “Sinkhole in the pavement”: an irregular patch, 1.20 by 1.00 metres, marked with the letters “So”.

acera_levantada.descripcion: A stretch of pavement with the slabs taken up: you step down a little onto sand or packed earth, with the odd loose lump.
acera_levantada.aviso: Pavement dug up: a small step down onto sand.
acera_levantada.imagen: Footprint of “Stretch of pavement dug up”: a rectangle, 2.00 by 1.50 metres, marked with the letters “Al”.

tunel_andamio.descripcion: Covered way under scaffolding: a plank floor that sounds hollow, tubes on both sides and a low roof. The sound changes as you go in, as in a corridor.
tunel_andamio.aviso: Scaffold tunnel: narrow way, plank floor and low roof.
tunel_andamio.imagen: Footprint of “Pedestrian tunnel under scaffolding”: a rectangle, 1.20 by 6.00 metres, marked with the letters “Ta”.

monton_arena.descripcion: A heap of sand tipped on the pavement or by the kerb. The cane sinks into it and your feet slip on the sand spread around.
monton_arena.imagen: Footprint of “Heap of builder's sand”: a heap with a rounded, uneven outline, 1.80 by 1.50 metres, marked with the letters “Ma”.

monton_adoquines.descripcion: Cobbles or slabs pulled up and piled anyhow. Hard, sharp-edged, with a few rolled away from the pile.
monton_adoquines.imagen: Footprint of “Pile of lifted cobbles”: an irregular patch, 1.50 by 1.20 metres, marked with the letters “Ma”.

pale_baldosas.nombre: Pallet of paving slabs on the pavement
pale_baldosas.descripcion: Wooden pallet loaded with slabs or bricks strapped together, hip high. Solid, with sharp corners; a loose strap can cut.
pale_baldosas.imagen: Footprint of “Pallet of paving slabs on the pavement”: a rectangle, 1.00 by 1.20 metres, marked with the letters “Pb”.

sacos_escombro.descripcion: Small woven sacks full of rubble, stacked against the wall or by the door of a flat being refurbished. Soft outside, hard inside; they shed dust.
sacos_escombro.imagen: Footprint of “Stacked rubble sacks”: a rectangle with rounded corners, 1.20 by 0.60 metres, marked with the letters “Se”.

bordillos_apilados.descripcion: Concrete kerbstones stacked two or three high, at knee height. Heavy, they do not move; they hurt your shins.
bordillos_apilados.imagen: Footprint of “Stacked kerbstones”: a rectangle, 1.00 by 0.60 metres, marked with the letters “Ba”.

tubos_acopiados.nombre: Works pipes lying on the ground
tubos_acopiados.descripcion: Long plastic pipes left along the pavement. Low and round: step on them and they roll.
tubos_acopiados.imagen: Footprint of “Works pipes lying on the ground”: a rectangle, 0.80 by 4.00 metres, marked with the letters “Ta”.

bobina_cable.descripcion: Big wooden reel wound with cable, standing on its two discs. Unless chocked, it rolls when pushed.
bobina_cable.imagen: Footprint of “Cable drum”: a rectangle, 0.80 by 1.25 metres, marked with the letters “Bc”.

pasacables.descripcion: Rubber hump across the path protecting cables or hoses. You walk over it: a bump three fingers high that trips shuffling feet.
pasacables.aviso: Cable ramp: a hump on the ground.
pasacables.imagen: Footprint of “Rubber cable ramp”: a rectangle, 2.00 by 0.30 metres, marked with the letters “Pa”.

cables_mangueras_suelo.nombre: Works cables and hoses across the ground
cables_mangueras_suelo.descripcion: Loose cables and hoses crossing the pavement from a doorway to the machine. They do not block the way, but they catch your foot.
cables_mangueras_suelo.aviso: Cables on the ground: lift your feet.
cables_mangueras_suelo.imagen: Footprint of “Works cables and hoses across the ground”: a rectangle with wavy edges, 4.00 by 0.40 metres, marked with the letters “Cm”.

generador_obra.descripcion: Generator set: a metal box with handles that putters non-stop and blows hot air. You hear it from far off and it drowns the other street sounds.
generador_obra.imagen: Footprint of “Site generator”: a rectangle, 0.90 by 0.60 metres, marked with the letters “Go”.

compresor_martillo.descripcion: Wheeled compressor with a tow bar sticking out at the front and a worker breaking up the ground nearby. The noise masks the traffic: this is a place to ask for help.
compresor_martillo.imagen: Footprint of “Compressor with pneumatic drill”: a T shape, 1.50 by 2.20 metres, marked with the letters “Cm”.

foco_obra.descripcion: Floodlight on a tall tripod with widely spread legs. The legs take up more room than you expect and the lamp burns if touched.
foco_obra.imagen: Footprint of “Site floodlight on a tripod”: a 3-pointed star, 1.00 by 1.00 metres, marked with the letters “Fo”.

carretilla_obra.descripcion: One-wheeled barrow left on the pavement. The metal tub is at knee height and the two handles stick out behind at hand height.
carretilla_obra.imagen: Footprint of “Wheelbarrow”: a tub with two handles to the back and a wheel at the pointed front, 0.60 by 1.40 metres, marked with the letters “Co”.

plataforma_tijera.descripcion: A machine with a basket that rises on a scissor arm. At the bottom it is a metal box with four outriggers sticking out at the corners; people are working above.
plataforma_tijera.imagen: Footprint of “Scissor lift”: a rectangle with a support sticking out at each corner, 1.80 by 2.80 metres, marked with the letters “Pt”.

andamio_con_red.nombre: Scaffolding wrapped in netting down to the ground
andamio_con_red.descripcion: Scaffolding covered with netting or sheeting that reaches the ground. It feels like a soft wall that gives and rustles; there is no way under it.
andamio_con_red.imagen: Footprint of “Scaffolding wrapped in netting down to the ground”: a rectangle, 5.00 by 1.00 metres, marked with the letters “Ac”.

puntal_marquesina.descripcion: A tube running diagonally from the scaffold down to the pavement. The cane finds its foot, but one step earlier the tube is already at chest or face height.
puntal_marquesina.imagen: Footprint of “Raking scaffold strut”: a rectangle, 0.10 by 1.20 metres, marked with the letters “Pm”.

bajante_escombros.descripcion: Wide chute of chained plastic buckets hanging down the façade and ending at head height. When rubble is tipped in, it rumbles and gives off dust.
bajante_escombros.imagen: Footprint of “Rubble chute”: a circle, 0.50 by 0.50 metres, hanging 1.50 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Be”.

polea_cubo.nombre: Pulley with a bucket going up and down
polea_cubo.descripcion: A bucket on a rope hauled up and down the façade with a pulley. It swings at body height; you hear the wheel squeak before you reach it.
polea_cubo.imagen: Footprint of “Pulley with a bucket going up and down”: a circle, 0.40 by 0.40 metres, hanging 1.00 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Pc”.

cuerda_colgando.descripcion: A rope or cable hanging from a balcony or a scaffold and stopping at chest height. It weighs nothing, but tangles round your neck or cane.
cuerda_colgando.imagen: Footprint of “Rope hanging down the façade”: a circle, 0.05 by 0.05 metres, hanging 1.00 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Cc”.

escalera_fachada.descripcion: Long ladder leaning on the wall with its feet a step out from the façade. Walking close to the wall you go under it and meet the rails at shoulder height.
escalera_fachada.imagen: Footprint of “Ladder leaning against the façade”: a rectangle, 0.45 by 1.20 metres, marked with the letters “Ef”.

muebles_mudanza.descripcion: Several pieces of furniture left on the pavement while they are carried up or loaded: bulks of different heights wrapped in blankets, with corners where you least expect them.
muebles_mudanza.imagen: Footprint of “Removal furniture on the pavement”: several straight-sided bulks of different sizes pushed together, 2.50 by 1.20 metres, marked with the letters “Mm”.

cajas_mudanza.descripcion: A tower of cardboard boxes by a doorway. Light: push it and it topples.
cajas_mudanza.imagen: Footprint of “Stacked removal boxes”: a rectangle, 1.00 by 0.50 metres, marked with the letters “Cm”.

plataforma_camion.descripcion: The tail lift of a delivery lorry, open flat at waist or chest height and reaching over the pavement. The cane passes underneath; the edge is sheet metal.
plataforma_camion.imagen: Footprint of “Lorry tail lift left open”: a rectangle, 2.40 by 1.60 metres, hanging 1.00 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Pc”.

rampa_furgoneta.nombre: Van ramp resting on the kerb
rampa_furgoneta.descripcion: Sheet-metal ramp running from the back of a van down to the pavement. A short, steep slope that rings like metal; from the side it is a step that trips you.
rampa_furgoneta.aviso: Delivery ramp across the path: a metal slope.
rampa_furgoneta.imagen: Footprint of “Van ramp resting on the kerb”: a trapezoid, narrower at the back, 0.90 by 2.20 metres, marked with the letters “Rf”.

carretilla_reparto.descripcion: Two-wheeled sack truck with a stack of boxes, left standing by a shop door. Narrow and tall; touch it and it may tip.
carretilla_reparto.imagen: Footprint of “Sack truck loaded with boxes”: a rectangle, 0.50 by 0.60 metres, marked with the letters “Cr”.

transpaleta_pale.descripcion: A loaded, shrink-wrapped pallet with the pallet truck still under it. The handle sticks out in front at waist height and the forks show at ground level.
transpaleta_pale.imagen: Footprint of “Delivery pallet with pallet truck”: a T shape, 0.80 by 1.90 metres, marked with the letters “Tp”.

jaula_reparto.descripcion: Tall wire-mesh trolley full of goods, taller than a person. It rolls if pushed and rattles like wire.
jaula_reparto.imagen: Footprint of “Roll cage”: a rectangle, 0.72 by 0.80 metres, marked with the letters “Jr”.

barriles_cerveza.descripcion: Metal kegs the drayman leaves at the bar door, knee high. They ring hollow; when empty, they roll.
barriles_cerveza.imagen: Footprint of “Beer kegs on the pavement”: an elongated oval with straight sides and round ends, 0.80 by 0.40 metres, marked with the letters “Bc”.

bombonas_butano.descripcion: Gas cylinders the delivery man stands by the doorway, at knee height. Thick steel; struck, they ring like a dull bell.
bombonas_butano.imagen: Footprint of “Gas cylinders on the pavement”: a rectangle with rounded corners, 0.60 by 0.30 metres, marked with the letters “Bb”.

cajas_bebida.descripcion: Plastic crates of bottles stacked in a column at a bar door. The bottles clink when brushed; the column is unsteady.
cajas_bebida.imagen: Footprint of “Stacked drinks crates”: a rectangle, 0.80 by 0.30 metres, marked with the letters “Cb”.

reparto_puerta_cerrada.nombre: Delivery left at a closed shop door
reparto_puerta_cerrada.descripcion: Bread baskets, bundles of newspapers or trays left before dawn in front of the shutter. Low, ankle to knee high, right on the threshold.
reparto_puerta_cerrada.imagen: Footprint of “Delivery left at a closed shop door”: a rectangle, 1.00 by 0.50 metres, marked with the letters “Rp”.

bolsas_basura_monton.descripcion: Rubbish bags left on the ground next to a full container. Soft, crackly, smelly, and sometimes leaking something slippery.
bolsas_basura_monton.imagen: Footprint of “Heap of rubbish bags”: an irregular patch, 1.50 by 1.00 metres, marked with the letters “Bb”.

bolsa_basura_suelta.nombre: Stray rubbish bag on the pavement
bolsa_basura_suelta.descripcion: A single rubbish bag in the middle of the pavement. Low and soft: the cane pushes it almost without feeling it.
bolsa_basura_suelta.imagen: Footprint of “Stray rubbish bag on the pavement”: a teardrop, round at the back and pointed at the front, 0.45 by 0.45 metres, marked with the letters “Bb”.

contenedor_volcado.descripcion: A wheelie bin lying on the pavement, lid open and rubbish spilt in front. Knee high and across the path.
contenedor_volcado.imagen: Footprint of “Wheelie bin knocked over”: a rectangle, 0.60 by 1.30 metres, marked with the letters “Cv”.

cubos_comunidad_fila.nombre: Building's bins put out for collection
cubos_comunidad_fila.descripcion: A row of wheelie bins the caretaker puts at the edge of the pavement in the evening and takes in next morning. They make a hollow plastic wall at chest height.
cubos_comunidad_fila.imagen: Footprint of “Building's bins put out for collection”: a rectangle, 2.40 by 0.75 metres, marked with the letters “Cc”.

carrito_barrendero.descripcion: Two-wheeled cart with a big bin, and brooms and a shovel whose handles stick out above and to the sides.
carrito_barrendero.imagen: Footprint of “Street sweeper's cart, parked”: a rectangle, 0.70 by 1.20 metres, marked with the letters “Cb”.

cristales_rotos.descripcion: A broken bottle or pane scattered over the pavement. It does not block the way: it crunches and tinkles underfoot. Dangerous for a guide dog and for hands.
cristales_rotos.imagen: Footprint of “Broken glass on the ground”: an irregular patch, 0.80 by 0.60 metres, marked with the letters “Cr”.

colchon_fachada.nombre: Old mattress leaning against the wall
colchon_fachada.descripcion: A mattress on its edge, leaning on the wall by the containers. Soft and tall; the wind blows it over and across the pavement.
colchon_fachada.imagen: Footprint of “Old mattress leaning against the wall”: a rectangle, 1.90 by 0.40 metres, marked with the letters “Cf”.

sofa_viejo.descripcion: A sofa left on the pavement for bulky-waste collection. Soft, knee high, with its cushions loose on the ground.
sofa_viejo.imagen: Footprint of “Old sofa left for collection”: a rectangle, 1.90 by 0.90 metres, marked with the letters “Sv”.

frigorifico_tumbado.nombre: Old fridge lying on its side
frigorifico_tumbado.descripcion: A fridge lying on the pavement, knee high. Smooth metal that sounds hollow; the door may be open and in the way.
frigorifico_tumbado.imagen: Footprint of “Old fridge lying on its side”: a rectangle, 0.60 by 1.80 metres, marked with the letters “Ft”.

trastos_viejos_monton.nombre: Old junk piled up for collection
trastos_viejos_monton.descripcion: Dismantled furniture, boards, a bed base and drawers piled anyhow by the containers. Boards stick out at mid height and may have nails.
trastos_viejos_monton.imagen: Footprint of “Old junk piled up for collection”: a heap with a rounded, uneven outline, 2.00 by 1.20 metres, marked with the letters “Tv”.

manguera_baldeo.descripcion: Thick hose the cleaning crew runs from the hydrant. A round hump on the ground; everything around is wet and you can hear the jet.
manguera_baldeo.aviso: Hose on the ground and wet pavement.
manguera_baldeo.imagen: Footprint of “Street-washing hose across the pavement”: a rectangle with wavy edges, 4.00 by 0.20 metres, marked with the letters “Mb”.

balsa_agua.descripcion: A very large puddle filling the pavement from side to side, or the dip of a crossing. You wade through: ankle-deep water and a slippery bottom.
balsa_agua.imagen: Footprint of “Standing water after rain”: a heap with a rounded, uneven outline, 3.50 by 2.50 metres, marked with the letters “Ba”.

placa_hielo.descripcion: Frozen water on the pavement, in the shade or by a fountain. You neither hear it nor feel it with the cane: your foot suddenly goes.
placa_hielo.aviso: Ice! The ground is very slippery: take short steps.
placa_hielo.imagen: Footprint of “Patch of ice”: an oval, 1.50 by 1.00 metres, marked with the letters “Ph”.

hojas_mojadas.descripcion: A layer of soaked fallen leaves covering the pavement in autumn. Soft and slippery; it hides the kerb and the tactile paving.
hojas_mojadas.imagen: Footprint of “Wet leaves on the ground”: an irregular patch, 2.50 by 1.50 metres, marked with the letters “Hm”.

silla_terraza_suelta.nombre: Stray terrace chair on the pavement
silla_terraza_suelta.descripcion: A café chair someone has pulled away from its table and left in the middle of the path. Light, metal or plastic: it shifts and scrapes when touched.
silla_terraza_suelta.imagen: Footprint of “Stray terrace chair on the pavement”: a rectangle, 0.55 by 0.55 metres, marked with the letters “St”.

terraza_apilada.descripcion: A tower of café chairs and tables stacked and chained together, left on the pavement when the terrace is closed. Legs and arms stick out at different heights.
terraza_apilada.imagen: Footprint of “Stacked terrace chairs and tables”: a rectangle, 1.20 by 0.70 metres, marked with the letters “Ta”.

sombrilla_tumbada.nombre: Closed parasol lying on the ground
sombrilla_tumbada.descripcion: A folded terrace parasol lying along the pavement. A long, low roll of fabric with the pole inside.
sombrilla_tumbada.imagen: Footprint of “Closed parasol lying on the ground”: a rectangle, 0.25 by 2.50 metres, marked with the letters “St”.

vela_publicitaria.descripcion: Flexible pole on a cross foot, with a tall, narrow cloth flapping at face height. The cane finds the foot; the cloth whips in the wind and you hear it snap.
vela_publicitaria.imagen: Footprint of “Feather flag”: a cross, 0.60 by 0.60 metres, marked with the letters “Vp”.

atril_carta.descripcion: Thin post on a heavy base, with the menu on a sloping tray at chest height. The tray overhangs the base.
atril_carta.imagen: Footprint of “Restaurant menu stand”: a rectangle, 0.45 by 0.40 metres, marked with the letters “Ac”.

figura_publicitaria.descripcion: A person-sized fibreglass figure (a chef, a giant ice cream) standing by a shop entrance. Hollow and light; it wobbles.
figura_publicitaria.imagen: Footprint of “Advertising figure by the door”: a circle, 0.60 by 0.60 metres, marked with the letters “Fp”.

cajas_fruta_vacias.descripcion: A column of empty thin-wood or plastic crates by the greengrocer's door. Very light: one touch brings it down.
cajas_fruta_vacias.imagen: Footprint of “Stacked empty fruit crates”: a rectangle, 0.50 by 0.40 metres, marked with the letters “Cf”.

perchero_rebajas.descripcion: A wheeled rail full of hanging clothes put out by the shop door. The clothes brush you first; underneath, the cane passes freely as far as the wheels.
perchero_rebajas.imagen: Footprint of “Sale rail on the pavement”: a rectangle, 1.40 by 0.50 metres, marked with the letters “Pr”.

cajon_ofertas.nombre: Bargain bin by the shop door
cajon_ofertas.descripcion: A big bin or basket on legs, full of jumbled goods, hip high and one step out from the shop front.
cajon_ofertas.imagen: Footprint of “Bargain bin by the shop door”: a rectangle, 0.80 by 0.60 metres, marked with the letters “Co”.

macetas_puerta.nombre: Flowerpots put out by the door
macetas_puerta.descripcion: A row of small flowerpots on the ground beside a shop door. Low, ankle to knee high; they sound like earthenware.
macetas_puerta.imagen: Footprint of “Flowerpots put out by the door”: a rectangle with rounded corners, 1.20 by 0.30 metres, marked with the letters “Mp”.

alfombra_arrugada.descripcion: A big entrance mat that has shifted and rucked up, or has a curled corner. It does not block the way, but it catches your toe and the cane tip.
alfombra_arrugada.imagen: Footprint of “Rucked-up shop doormat”: a rectangle, 1.50 by 0.90 metres, marked with the letters “Aa”.

persiana_medio_abrir.descripcion: A shop shutter raised only to forehead height. The cane goes under without touching it; the edge is a steel section.
persiana_medio_abrir.imagen: Footprint of “Half-raised metal shutter”: a rectangle, 2.50 by 0.08 metres, hanging 1.50 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Pm”.

puerta_cristal_acera.nombre: Glass door open onto the pavement
puerta_cristal_acera.descripcion: The glass leaf of a shop door open outwards, at right angles to the façade. Walking close to the wall you hit its thin, cold edge; it can be neither seen nor heard.
puerta_cristal_acera.imagen: Footprint of “Glass door open onto the pavement”: a rectangle, 0.05 by 0.90 metres, marked with the letters “Pc”.

viento_puesto.nombre: Awning guy rope tied to a weight
viento_puesto.descripcion: A taut rope running diagonally from a stall awning down to a water drum or block on the ground. The cane finds the weight; the almost invisible rope crosses earlier at chest height.
viento_puesto.imagen: Footprint of “Awning guy rope tied to a weight”: a teardrop, round at the back and pointed at the front, 0.30 by 1.20 metres, marked with the letters “Vp”.

mesa_puesto.descripcion: Long board on trestles, covered with goods hanging over the edge. The trestles are set in: the cane goes under the board before touching them.
mesa_puesto.imagen: Footprint of “Stall table on trestles”: a rectangle, 2.00 by 0.80 metres, marked with the letters “Mp”.

cajas_puesto.nombre: Boxes and bags on the ground by a stall
cajas_puesto.descripcion: Boxes, bags and goods spread on the ground in front of or beside a stall. Low and untidy: it changes every time the trader restocks.
cajas_puesto.imagen: Footprint of “Boxes and bags on the ground by a stall”: an irregular patch, 1.20 by 0.80 metres, marked with the letters “Cp”.

genero_colgado.nombre: Goods hanging from a stall awning
genero_colgado.descripcion: Clothes, bags or strings of goods hanging from the awning edge at face height. Soft, but they hit your head with no warning from the cane.
genero_colgado.imagen: Footprint of “Goods hanging from a stall awning”: a rectangle, 2.00 by 0.40 metres, hanging 1.50 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Gc”.

carpa_plegable.descripcion: Square canopy on four legs, with a weight on each leg sticking outwards. The folding roof bars are at head height along the edges.
carpa_plegable.imagen: Footprint of “Pop-up gazebo with weights”: a rectangle with a support sticking out at each corner, 3.00 by 3.00 metres, marked with the letters “Cp”.

caseta_feria.descripcion: Board booth with a counter at the front and a hinged flap above, like those at Christmas markets. The open flap is at head height.
caseta_feria.imagen: Footprint of “Wooden fair booth”: a house-shaped pentagon, 3.00 by 2.00 metres, marked with the letters “Cf”.

puesto_castanas.descripcion: A steel drum of embers with a small table beside it. It burns if touched; you know it from afar by the smell and the crackle of the embers.
puesto_castanas.imagen: Footprint of “Roast chestnut stand”: an oval, 1.00 by 0.80 metres, marked with the letters “Pc”.

churreria_ambulante.descripcion: Long trailer with a high counter on one side, a drop-down awning and a generator that never stops. There is a queue in front and the ground is sticky with oil and sugar.
churreria_ambulante.imagen: Footprint of “Mobile churro stall”: a rectangle with cut corners, 4.50 by 2.30 metres, marked with the letters “Ca”.

carrito_helados.descripcion: A cart with two big wheels, a cold box and a small canopy. The seller moves it around during the day.
carrito_helados.imagen: Footprint of “Ice cream cart”: a rectangle, 0.80 by 1.50 metres, marked with the letters “Ch”.

cabina_aseo_portatil.descripcion: Plastic cabin with a door that slams, set on the pavement or square for a festival or building works. Hollow when struck; you know it by the smell.
cabina_aseo_portatil.imagen: Footprint of “Portable toilet cabin”: a rectangle, 1.20 by 1.20 metres, marked with the letters “Ca”.

escenario_provisional.descripcion: A high platform set up in the square on a tubular frame, with steps at one side. The edge is at chest height and underneath are crossed bars.
escenario_provisional.imagen: Footprint of “Temporary stage”: a rectangle, 8.00 by 6.00 metres, marked with the letters “Ep”.

torre_sonido.descripcion: Metal lattice tower with loudspeakers on top and four outriggers in a cross, loaded with drums. Cables run from it across the ground.
torre_sonido.imagen: Footprint of “Speaker tower with ballast”: a cross, 1.50 by 1.50 metres, marked with the letters “Ts”.

sillas_procesion.nombre: Rows of chairs set out for the procession
sillas_procesion.descripcion: Rows of folding chairs tied together that take over the pavement hours before a procession or parade. They leave a narrow way along the wall.
sillas_procesion.imagen: Footprint of “Rows of chairs set out for the procession”: a rectangle, 5.00 by 0.55 metres, marked with the letters “Sp”.

tribuna_desmontable.descripcion: A stand of tubes and planks put up in the street. Behind and at the sides it is a forest of crossed tubes at every height; in front, steps.
tribuna_desmontable.imagen: Footprint of “Demountable grandstand”: a trapezoid, narrower at the back, 8.00 by 5.00 metres, marked with the letters “Td”.

pata_arco_hinchable.descripcion: A fat, soft column of air-filled fabric, one of the two legs of a race start arch. A blower hums at its foot and guy ropes run from it to weights.
pata_arco_hinchable.imagen: Footprint of “Inflatable arch leg with blower”: a circle, 1.20 by 1.20 metres, marked with the letters “Pa”.

alfombra_cronometraje.descripcion: A rubber mat with cables across the road at the start and finish of a race. You step on it: it is soft and beeps when a race number crosses.
alfombra_cronometraje.imagen: Footprint of “Finish-line timing mat”: a rectangle, 4.00 by 1.00 metres, marked with the letters “Ac”.

mesa_avituallamiento.descripcion: Folding tables in a row at the roadside with cups and bottles. All around, the ground is littered with cups, bottle tops and water.
mesa_avituallamiento.imagen: Footprint of “Race refreshment table”: a rectangle, 3.60 by 0.75 metres, marked with the letters “Ma”.

mesa_petitoria.descripcion: A folding table with a cloth skirt, a collecting tin and one or two people sitting behind, set up on a busy corner. They usually call out to passers-by.
mesa_petitoria.imagen: Footprint of “Collection or petition table”: a rectangle, 1.20 by 1.20 metres, marked with the letters “Mp”.

barra_fiestas.descripcion: A long bar of planks on barrels or trestles, set up in the street during the festival. Elbow high; the ground in front is wet and sticky.
barra_fiestas.imagen: Footprint of “Temporary festival bar”: a rectangle, 4.00 by 0.60 metres, marked with the letters “Bf”.

jaula_vidrio_fiestas.descripcion: Wheeled wire-mesh cage for bottles, placed around the streets at festival time. It rattles like wire and, when a bottle goes in, like glass.
jaula_vidrio_fiestas.imagen: Footprint of “Festival glass-collection cage”: a rectangle, 1.20 by 1.00 metres, marked with the letters “Jv”.

guirnalda_baja.descripcion: A string of bulbs or bunting stretched from side to side that has sagged and crosses the path at forehead height. The cane does not touch it.
guirnalda_baja.imagen: Footprint of “Low-hanging string of lights”: a rectangle, 5.00 by 0.10 metres, hanging 1.60 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Gb”.

arbol_navidad_plaza.nombre: Fenced Christmas tree in the square
arbol_navidad_plaza.descripcion: A very tall metal cone covered in lights in the middle of the square, ringed with low barriers. It stands where on other days you would walk straight across.
arbol_navidad_plaza.imagen: Footprint of “Fenced Christmas tree in the square”: an octagon, 5.00 by 5.00 metres, marked with the letters “An”.

hoguera_vallada.descripcion: A tall pile of wood, or a cardboard monument due to be burnt, ringed with barriers at a junction or square. Once lit, you hear it crackle and feel the heat from afar.
hoguera_vallada.imagen: Footprint of “Fenced bonfire or festival monument”: a circle, 6.00 by 6.00 metres, marked with the letters “Hv”.

rama_caida.nombre: Large fallen branch on the pavement
rama_caida.descripcion: A thick branch brought down by a storm, with thin branches and leaves going every way. The cane tangles and the tips scratch at leg and hand height.
rama_caida.imagen: Footprint of “Large fallen branch on the pavement”: a branch with several arms going off in different directions, 3.00 by 2.00 metres, marked with the letters “Rc”.

arbol_caido.descripcion: A whole tree lying from side to side: the trunk at hip height, the crown a tangle and, at the other end, the root plate lifted with a hole beside it.
arbol_caido.imagen: Footprint of “Fallen tree across the street”: a trunk lying down, roots on the left and the wide crown on the right, 8.00 by 3.50 metres, marked with the letters “Ac”.

restos_poda.nombre: Heap of pruning branches and leaves
restos_poda.descripcion: Freshly cut branches heaped on the pavement or road, waiting for the lorry. Soft and springy; the leaves rustle in the breeze.
restos_poda.imagen: Footprint of “Heap of pruning branches and leaves”: a heap with a rounded, uneven outline, 2.50 by 1.50 metres, marked with the letters “Rp”.

toldo_roto.descripcion: An awning ripped by the wind: the canvas and a bar hang from the façade down to chest height and swing. You can hear the cloth snap.
toldo_roto.imagen: Footprint of “Torn awning hanging down”: a rectangle, 2.00 by 0.60 metres, hanging 1.20 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Tr”.

cable_caido.descripcion: A cable that has come away from the façade or a pole and hangs diagonally to the ground. It may be live: do not touch it, not even with the cane.
cable_caido.aviso: Fallen cable! Do not touch it: give it a wide berth.
cable_caido.imagen: Footprint of “Fallen overhead cable”: a rectangle, 0.10 by 3.00 metres, marked with the letters “Cc”.

cascotes_acotados.descripcion: Pieces of cornice or tiles fallen at the foot of a façade, ringed with barriers. Outside the barriers loose lumps lie on the ground.
cascotes_acotados.aviso: Falling masonry: move away from the wall.
cascotes_acotados.imagen: Footprint of “Fallen masonry, cordoned off”: a rectangle with cut corners, 2.50 by 2.00 metres, marked with the letters “Ca”.

macetero_volcado.descripcion: A big pot blown over by the wind, with soil and plant spilt in front. The wet soil is slippery.
macetero_volcado.imagen: Footprint of “Overturned planter”: a teardrop, round at the back and pointed at the front, 0.60 by 1.20 metres, marked with the letters “Mv”.

senal_derribada.descripcion: A sign post lying across the pavement after wind or a collision. Low, metal, with the plate at one end and the torn-out base at the other.
senal_derribada.imagen: Footprint of “Knocked-down road sign”: a rectangle, 0.60 by 2.80 metres, marked with the letters “Sd”.

valla_tumbada.descripcion: A metal barrier fallen flat on the pavement. It is barely a hand high: your foot goes between the bars and the cane catches.
valla_tumbada.imagen: Footprint of “Works barrier blown flat”: a rectangle, 2.50 by 1.10 metres, marked with the letters “Vt”.

alcorque_inundado.descripcion: A tree pit full of water after rain or watering. It seems firm ground, but your foot sinks into a hand's depth of water and mud.
alcorque_inundado.aviso: Flooded tree pit: water and mud.
alcorque_inundado.imagen: Footprint of “Flooded tree pit”: a rectangle, 1.00 by 1.00 metres, marked with the letters “Ai”.

arrastre_barro.nombre: Mud and gravel washed down by the storm
arrastre_barro.descripcion: A tongue of mud, gravel and twigs left on the pavement by the rain. You walk on it: it crunches, slides and hides the kerb.
arrastre_barro.imagen: Footprint of “Mud and gravel washed down by the storm”: an irregular patch, 3.00 by 1.50 metres, marked with the letters “Ab”.

nieve_amontonada.descripcion: A bank of cleared snow left along the kerb or against the wall. Soft outside, hard inside once it freezes; it hides the kerb and the dropped kerbs.
nieve_amontonada.imagen: Footprint of “Snow piled at the edge”: a rectangle with rounded corners, 3.00 by 0.80 metres, marked with the letters “Na”.

cola_de_gente.nombre: Queue of people outside a shop
cola_de_gente.descripcion: A line of people waiting on the pavement, crossing it from door to kerb. You hear the murmur; ask to get through and the line opens.
cola_de_gente.imagen: Footprint of “Queue of people outside a shop”: a rectangle with wavy edges, 0.80 by 6.00 metres, marked with the letters “Cd”.

grupo_charlando.descripcion: A knot of several people standing in the middle of the pavement. You hear the voices from afar; they do not move unless warned.
grupo_charlando.imagen: Footprint of “Group of people standing chatting”: a circle, 1.80 by 1.80 metres, marked with the letters “Gc”.

persona_parada.nombre: Person standing in the middle of the pavement
persona_parada.descripcion: Someone standing still in the way, looking at a phone or waiting. Silent: the cane touches their feet. A simple “excuse me” does it.
persona_parada.imagen: Footprint of “Person standing in the middle of the pavement”: an oval, 0.60 by 0.50 metres, marked with the letters “Pp”.

persona_sentada_suelo.descripcion: Someone sitting on the pavement, back to the wall and legs stretched into the path. Low and soft: the cane meets their feet.
persona_sentada_suelo.imagen: Footprint of “Person sitting on the ground”: a rectangle with rounded corners, 0.60 by 1.20 metres, marked with the letters “Ps”.

vecinos_al_fresco.nombre: Neighbours sitting out by their door
vecinos_al_fresco.descripcion: Several chairs brought out onto the pavement in a ring in front of a doorway, with neighbours chatting. The kerb side is left clear; you hear them from afar.
vecinos_al_fresco.imagen: Footprint of “Neighbours sitting out by their door”: a curved band bulging towards the front, 2.50 by 1.20 metres, marked with the letters “Va”.

perro_atado.nombre: Dog tied up on a stretched lead
perro_atado.descripcion: A dog tied to a lamp post or ring while its owner shops. The lead crosses the path at ankle height and the dog moves, pants and barks.
perro_atado.imagen: Footprint of “Dog tied up on a stretched lead”: a teardrop, round at the back and pointed at the front, 0.50 by 1.50 metres, marked with the letters “Pa”.

musico_callejero.nombre: Busker with an open instrument case
musico_callejero.descripcion: A musician playing standing or seated, with the instrument case open on the ground one step in front. The music guides you from afar and masks the traffic up close.
musico_callejero.imagen: Footprint of “Busker with an open instrument case”: a T shape, 1.50 by 1.50 metres, marked with the letters “Mc”.

estatua_humana.descripcion: A motionless performer standing on a box, with a tin for coins in front. Completely silent until someone drops a coin; a ring of people gathers round.
estatua_humana.imagen: Footprint of “Living statue on a plinth”: a house-shaped pentagon, 0.60 by 0.80 metres, marked with the letters “Eh”.

manta_venta.nombre: Street seller's blanket on the ground
manta_venta.descripcion: A sheet spread on the ground with goods on it and cords at the corners. Do not step on it: feet tangle and the goods slide.
manta_venta.aviso: Seller's blanket on the ground: go round it.
manta_venta.imagen: Footprint of “Street seller's blanket on the ground”: a rectangle, 2.00 by 1.50 metres, marked with the letters “Mv”.

cochecito_bebe.nombre: Pushchair left by a shop door
cochecito_bebe.descripcion: A pushchair parked by a shop entrance. The handle is at waist height; unless the brake is on, it rolls.
cochecito_bebe.imagen: Footprint of “Pushchair left by a shop door”: a rectangle with cut corners, 0.60 by 1.00 metres, marked with the letters “Cb”.

carro_compra_puerta.nombre: Shopping trolley bag left by the door
carro_compra_puerta.descripcion: A two-wheeled shopping trolley with a fabric bag, leaning by a shop door. Narrow and light: it falls over when brushed.
carro_compra_puerta.imagen: Footprint of “Shopping trolley bag left by the door”: a rectangle, 0.40 by 0.35 metres, marked with the letters “Cc”.

suelo_recien_fregado.descripcion: A patch of wet floor that has not dried yet. The cane does not find it: it smells of bleach and your shoes slip or squeak.
suelo_recien_fregado.imagen: Footprint of “Stretch of freshly mopped floor”: an irregular patch, 2.00 by 2.00 metres, marked with the letters “Sr”.

carro_limpieza.nombre: Cleaning trolley left in the corridor
carro_limpieza.descripcion: A trolley with buckets, a big hanging rubbish bag and broom handles sticking up. It takes up half the corridor by the door being cleaned.
carro_limpieza.imagen: Footprint of “Cleaning trolley left in the corridor”: a rectangle, 0.60 by 1.20 metres, marked with the letters “Cl”.

fregadora_suelos.descripcion: A machine pushed around the lobby by an operator: it hums, scrubs and leaves a wet strip behind. When stopped, it is a hip-high plastic bulk with a cable or handle at the back.
fregadora_suelos.imagen: Footprint of “Floor scrubber machine”: a rectangle with rounded corners, 0.60 by 1.20 metres, marked with the letters “Fs”.

cubo_gotera.descripcion: A bucket set on the floor to catch water dripping from the ceiling. Low, in the middle of the way, with the floor splashed around it.
cubo_gotera.imagen: Footprint of “Bucket under a leak”: a circle, 0.30 by 0.30 metres, marked with the letters “Cg”.

andamio_pintor.descripcion: A wheeled tube tower with a platform on top, in the middle of a corridor or lobby. Cross bars run at several heights and a painter is on top.
andamio_pintor.imagen: Footprint of “Painter's mobile scaffold tower”: a rectangle, 0.80 by 2.00 metres, marked with the letters “Ap”.

plastico_pintor.nombre: Painter's dust sheet on the floor
plastico_pintor.descripcion: A plastic sheet spread out to protect the floor. It crackles underfoot, slides and tangles round your feet and the cane tip.
plastico_pintor.aviso: Painter's sheet on the floor: slippery.
plastico_pintor.imagen: Footprint of “Painter's dust sheet on the floor”: a rectangle, 3.00 by 2.00 metres, marked with the letters “Pp”.

cubos_pintura.descripcion: Big paint tubs, trays and rollers left on the floor by the wall being painted. Low; tip them and paint goes everywhere.
cubos_pintura.imagen: Footprint of “Paint tubs and rollers”: a heap with a rounded, uneven outline, 0.80 by 0.50 metres, marked with the letters “Cp”.

caja_herramientas_suelo.descripcion: An open toolbox with its trays spread out and the odd tool loose around it, where the maintenance worker is busy.
caja_herramientas_suelo.imagen: Footprint of “Open toolbox on the floor”: a rectangle, 0.50 by 0.30 metres, marked with the letters “Ch”.

alargador_cruzado.descripcion: A thin cable run from a socket to a machine, right across the corridor. It makes no sound and does not block the way: it catches your foot.
alargador_cruzado.aviso: Cable across the floor: lift your feet.
alargador_cruzado.imagen: Footprint of “Extension lead across the corridor”: a rectangle, 2.00 by 0.05 metres, marked with the letters “Ac”.

trampilla_registro_abierta.descripcion: A floor cover lifted to inspect services. It leaves a square hole a hand deep, with the cover propped beside it.
trampilla_registro_abierta.aviso: Open hatch! There is a hole in the floor.
trampilla_registro_abierta.imagen: Footprint of “Open floor access hatch”: a rectangle, 0.60 by 0.60 metres, marked with the letters “Tr”.

cajas_reposicion.nombre: Restocking boxes in a shop aisle
cajas_reposicion.descripcion: Open cardboard boxes on the floor while shelves are being restocked. Low, knee high, and in a different aisle every day.
cajas_reposicion.imagen: Footprint of “Restocking boxes in a shop aisle”: a rectangle, 0.60 by 0.40 metres, marked with the letters “Cr”.

carro_reposicion.descripcion: A low wheeled platform with a tall handle, loaded with boxes, stopped in the middle of an aisle. The platform sticks out in front at ankle height.
carro_reposicion.imagen: Footprint of “Stock trolley loaded with boxes”: a rectangle, 0.60 by 1.00 metres, marked with the letters “Cr”.

paquetes_entrada.nombre: Courier parcels piled in the entrance
paquetes_entrada.descripcion: A pile of parcels the courier leaves in the hallway or by reception. Boxes of all sizes, light, that spill over.
paquetes_entrada.imagen: Footprint of “Courier parcels piled in the entrance”: several straight-sided bulks of different sizes pushed together, 1.00 by 0.60 metres, marked with the letters “Pe”.

mueble_fuera_sitio.nombre: Piece of furniture moved out of place
mueble_fuera_sitio.descripcion: A piece of furniture pulled away from the wall for cleaning, building work or a move and left in the middle of the way, where there was never anything.
mueble_fuera_sitio.imagen: Footprint of “Piece of furniture moved out of place”: a rectangle, 1.00 by 0.50 metres, marked with the letters “Mf”.

sillas_con_cinta.descripcion: Two chairs set apart with a tape tied from back to back to close off a corridor. The cane may pass between them touching nothing: the tape is at hip height.
sillas_con_cinta.imagen: Footprint of ““No entry” tape between two chairs”: two squares joined by a thin strip, 2.00 by 0.50 metres, marked with the letters “Sc”.

alfombra_enrollada.descripcion: A carpet rolled up and left along a corridor for cleaning or building work. A soft roll at ankle height.
alfombra_enrollada.imagen: Footprint of “Rolled-up carpet on the floor”: a rectangle, 0.30 by 2.00 metres, marked with the letters “Ae”.

paraguas_abierto.nombre: Open umbrella drying on the floor
paraguas_abierto.descripcion: An open umbrella left on the entrance floor to dry. Light, with the rib tips at knee height; it rolls when touched and leaves a puddle.
paraguas_abierto.imagen: Footprint of “Open umbrella drying on the floor”: an octagon, 1.00 by 1.00 metres, marked with the letters “Pa”.

arbol_navidad_vestibulo.descripcion: A Christmas tree that appears in December in a corner or the middle of the lobby. The branches prickle and brush you before you reach the base; cables and parcels lie around it.
arbol_navidad_vestibulo.imagen: Footprint of “Christmas tree in the lobby”: a circle, 1.20 by 1.20 metres, marked with the letters “An”.

decoracion_colgada_baja.descripcion: Garlands, mobiles or card signs hung from the ceiling down to forehead height. Light: they do not hurt, but they startle and tangle.
decoracion_colgada_baja.imagen: Footprint of “Low-hanging decorations”: a rectangle, 1.50 by 0.30 metres, hanging 1.60 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Dc”.

puerta_alta_abierta.descripcion: The door of a wall cupboard someone has left open: its edge is at face height and the cane passes underneath.
puerta_alta_abierta.imagen: Footprint of “High cupboard door left open”: a rectangle, 0.04 by 0.45 metres, hanging 1.40 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Pa”.

ventana_abierta_paso.nombre: Window leaf open into the path
ventana_abierta_paso.descripcion: A casement window open into the corridor or out over the pavement. Its glass and aluminium edge is at chest and face height; there is nothing below it.
ventana_abierta_paso.imagen: Footprint of “Window leaf open into the path”: a rectangle, 0.05 by 0.60 metres, hanging 1.00 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Va”.
